title: Regression chart 迴歸直線
description:
Fit y=a*x+b using x=[1,2,3], y=[5,10,20]. Scatter the observed points. Plot the fitted line evaluated at those same three x values. Label axes Visits (100) and Sales (100); show a grid.

No input. Create the specified chart; no printed output is required. Chart properties are checked numerically, not by pixel matching.
hints: Useful functions: array(), polyfit(), scatter(), plot(), xlabel(), ylabel(), grid(), show().
Create the specified x values first, then calculate every y value from them.
Set the stated labels, styles and limits before plt.show(). Chart checks inspect properties, not pixels.
solution:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
x=np.array([1,2,3])
y=np.array([5,10,20])
a,b=np.polyfit(x,y,1)
plt.scatter(x,y)
plt.plot(x,a*x+b)
plt.xlabel("Visits (100)")
plt.ylabel("Sales (100)")
plt.grid()
plt.show()
